technologiesPage.title: Technologies we use and why our system is faster, safer, and more stable.
technologiesPage.subtitle: Our focus is product engineering: low latency, fewer production bugs, and robust operations to process location data.

tech.title: Tech stack
tech.subtitle: Every technology was selected to solve speed, reliability, continuous delivery, and user experience.

item1.reason: Bun shortens startup time and improves our deployment cycle.

item2.reason: Nuxt enables fast pages with a clean, scalable structure.

item3.impact: Flexible data model for geospatial layers
item3.reason: MongoDB makes schema evolution easier as the product grows.

item4.reason: TypeScript enforces explicit contracts across frontend and backend.

item5.reason: RabbitMQ orchestrates data processing, report generation, and async integrations.

item6.reason: Google Maps Platform provides geocoding and location data for every analysis.

item7.reason: NestJS organizes business rules by domain with strong maintainability.

item8.reason: Resend provides fast and traceable email notifications.

item9.reason: Docker standardizes development, QA and production.

item10.reason: Cloudflare protects the edge and accelerates global delivery.

item11.reason: Vue keeps components simple and user flows predictable.

bias.title: Superior technical foundation
bias.subtitle: This is what separates production-ready architecture from quick templates that accumulate failures.

item1.name: Production-oriented architecture
item1.trigger: Clear separation of concerns, typed contracts, and resilient messaging.
item1.outcome: Scales predictably instead of turning every new feature into rework.

item2.name: Security built into the foundation
item2.trigger: Data validation, service isolation, and active edge protection.
item2.outcome: Lower exposure to common vulnerabilities found in auto-generated boilerplates.

item3.name: Reliable async workflows
item3.trigger: Event queues process data, generate reports, and send notifications without blocking the app.
item3.outcome: The platform stays stable during usage spikes and high analysis volumes.

item4.name: Continuous quality and real maintainability
item4.trigger: Typed modular stack that supports testing, observability, and safe evolution.
item4.outcome: Fewer production bugs and sustainable delivery speed.

ethics.title: Serious engineering for real business
ethics.description: We build a platform for professional operations, not a fragile prototype. Performance, security, and consistency come first so location analysis works reliably every day.
